descriptor: File transfer manager for big project folders

voice.summary: Cargo Drop talks like a good logistics manager: it tells you what is moving, how fast and how long is left, and never dramatises a delay. Errors come with a clear retry.
dos: Report size, speed and time left in one line
Keep status text under ten words
donts: Do not use cute loading puns
Never say 'something went wrong' without naming the file

boilerplate: Cargo Drop is a file transfer manager that uploads large project folders reliably, showing per-file progress, speed and time remaining with pause, resume and retry.

microcopy.empty: No files queued. Drop some here.

logo.note: A cube stands for a parcel, the unit of cargo this tool moves.
